data.positive_recipe: 128 existing replay + 44 visually reviewed train pairs + 20 fixed-seed repeats of those reviewed pairs

evaluation: 108 pairs: previous 12-scene diagnostic (60) plus new 8-scene extension geometry/natural pairs (48). Exclude all synthetic appearance-change stress inputs from caption evaluation. Same original question and decoding for published baseline and candidate, sequentially on the same GPU container. Both passed through identical exact-sentence dedup before masked assessment.
selection_gate: Consider candidate promising only if physical false-positive count on new-scene nonidentity geometry controls decreases; new confirmed-natural fact hits do not decrease in either domain; old-natural fact hits do not decrease in either domain; new confirmed-natural unsupported-claim pair count does not increase. Uncertain clothesline natural pair reported separately. Otherwise retain published checkpoint. One candidate only, no recipe search after this outcome.
provenance: Recipe fixed after earlier caption-SFT and CPU-gate diagnostics; this is adaptive development, not a fresh preregistered external test. Source images for evaluation have already been viewed. No test paths or exact decoded-pixel duplicates permitted in this continued-training batch. Checkpoint already learned from official OmniDiff train; not training from scratch.
limits: Only one seed and small correlated scene set.
Synthetic 2D roll/crop/zoom does not establish 3D viewpoint robustness.
Training and geometry evaluation share augmentation family, so resampling artifacts are a possible shortcut.
Positive corrected captions reviewed by Codex, not independently human adjudicated.
This mix changes both label balance and continued-training exposure; cannot attribute a gain solely to hard negatives.
budget: One GPU candidate, bounded 3600 seconds, scaledown on function completion. CPU preparation first. No persistent endpoints, automation or extra configurations.
